root_cause: Two independent, pre-existing CI infrastructure/test issues combined to fail this run; neither is caused by the triggering commit (#37406, a GPU plugin build-system fix for prepare_ze_headers unrelated to packaging or caching). (1) The 'GPU unit tests' job's 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs Expand-Archive -Force against an install directory still containing tbb12.dll from a prior step on the same Windows self-hosted runner; Expand-Archive's Remove-Item call fails with UnauthorizedAccessException because the DLL is still locked (likely AV scanning or a stale handle from a prior job on a reused runner). This is the 5th occurrence of this exact signature in the past ~22 hours. (2) The 'C++ unit tests' job's CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race test (src/inference/tests/functional/caching_test.cpp:2670) races multiple threads against a mocked import_model() call with an exact EXPECT_CALL count; under Windows scheduling variance the race loop terminates one call short (6 vs expected 7), a known timing-sensitive test design flaw. Both failures then cascade into the 'ci/gha_overall_status_windows' aggregate check failing.
reproduction_steps: N/A for both failures - neither is reliably reproducible outside CI. (1) Requires the specific Windows self-hosted runner state with a locked tbb12.dll handle. (2) Requires building with -DENABLE_TESTS=ON and running `ov_inference_functional_tests --gtest_filter=CachingTest/CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race*` repeatedly on a loaded Windows machine; failure rate is low and timing-dependent.
recommended_actions: Escalate the recurring tbb12.dll lock issue (5th occurrence in ~22 hours) to the CI infrastructure team to investigate stale processes/AV locks on the Windows self-hosted runner pool for GPU unit tests.
Add a retry-with-delay wrapper around the Expand-Archive/Remove-Item extraction step for Windows jobs, or switch to 7zip/robocopy-based extraction that tolerates locked destination files.

Relax the exact EXPECT_CALL(*mockPlugin, import_model(...)).Times(N) expectation in caching_test.cpp around line 2670 to a range-based expectation (e.g., AtLeast), or add a synchronization barrier after the racing threads join and before Mock::VerifyAndClearExpectations.
Consider quarantining CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race / LoadMulti_race as known-flaky on Windows pending the test design fix, given this is now the 2nd recorded occurrence.
prevention_strategies: Wrap Windows archive-extraction steps with a retry loop when Remove-Item/Expand-Archive fails with UnauthorizedAccessException, and recycle Windows runner images periodically to clear stale locked handles. Separately, avoid asserting exact gmock call counts in deliberately-racy multi-threaded tests; prefer bounded ranges (AtLeast/Between) and explicit synchronization before verifying mock expectations.
historical_context: The tbb12.dll extraction signature (514ffa2ab52ad344) was previously recorded on 2026-11-09T16:30:00Z, 2026-11-10T09:02:45Z, and 2026-11-10T10:05:38Z (runs 42626586527, 42775441636, 42783108480) - this is the 5th occurrence within roughly 22 hours, strongly confirming an unresolved recurring Windows-runner infrastructure issue. The CachingTest.LoadMultiWithConfig_race signature (9f9ea52f699d8da3) was first recorded on 2026-11-09T23:43:11Z (run 42699508369) with a 5-vs-6 call-count mismatch; this run reproduces the same race condition with a 6-vs-7 mismatch, confirming it as a recurring flaky test rather than a one-off.
